title: Replace DateTime.now() with a fixed clock in dashboard_providers_test's streak fixture
why: The seeded streak event's dayUtc is derived from this real-clock read, then the test asserts dashboardStreakProvider.currentStreak >= 1 for 'today'. If the process clock crosses UTC midnight between this read and the provider's own internal 'now' computation — a real, if rare, window on a loaded CI runner — the seeded event lands on 'yesterday' relative to the provider and the test fails intermittently with no code change: the classic wall-clock flake TQ-6 exists to prevent. Every other test in this 1325-line file already uses a fixed DateTime.utc(...) constant.
recommendation: Use a fixed DateTime.utc(2026, 5, 20) (or similar) instead of DateTime.now().
acceptance_criteria: dashboard_providers_test.dart contains zero calls to DateTime.now()
